proposed.explanation: Given the investor's 5-7 year horizon aimed at funding university fees, medium risk tolerance, and a separate emergency fund, Telecom Egypt (ETEL) presents strong financial performance that aligns with long-term growth. Operating revenues increased from 81,677,800,000 EGP in 2024 to 106,673,000,000 EGP in 2025. Net profit for the year rose significantly from 10,111,300,000 EGP in 2024 to 22,578,100,000 EGP in 2025, with basic and diluted EPS increasing from 4.79 EGP to 11.93 EGP. Buying 140 shares at 141.95 EGP per share costs 19,873.00 EGP, which fits comfortably within the available cash balance of 20,000.00 EGP, leaving 127.00 EGP in cash.
